userFeedback: 我感觉明显还是rev 12细节更多吧
assessment: Correct. Rev13 reduced authored RGB to luminance, changed rev12 flake/roughness tuning, omitted roughness and normal sampling from the motif layer, and let the crystal pass resample scene color.
architecture: Rev12 detail sampling on rev13 physical cap-only meshes: substrate inset 0.28 mm, motif inset 0.14 mm, crystal surface at the existing exterior boundary.
textureLineage: All nine textures are the same Unity assets referenced by rev12; no copies or resampling.
textureImporter: Native 620x1000 where applicable, no NPOT scale, mipmaps enabled, bilinear filtering, clamp, uncompressed default; motif masks sample LOD0 for crisp boundaries.
estimatedMobileCost: Per face: substrate 3 texture + 2 cubemap samples; motif 3 texture + 1 cubemap sample on motif pixels; crystal 1 scene-color + 1 cubemap sample. About 4 additional draw calls and one transparent overdraw layer versus rev12; no device GPU timing.
